info.title: ScamShield API
info.description: Finds and scores UAE-brand scam sites. Every response carries the header X-ScamShield-Mode: mock | live.

get.description:
Accuracy on the held-out test set (scripts/evaluate.py --save).
Falls back to clearly-labelled sample numbers if no evaluation has been saved.
Audit log: every confirm / dismiss across all cases, newest first.

Newest auto-discovered URLs first (manual, citizen and batch excluded). The counts ignore
the filters, so tab and chip numbers stay put while filtering.

post.description: Confirm or dismiss. Needs a logged-in analyst or admin; the log keeps who, when, why.

get.description:
Police-ready evidence report: verdict, reasons, screenshot, WHOIS, hosting, redirects,
related domains, analyst decisions and takedown contacts. Downloads as a file.

Evidence bundle for hand-over: the full case, the takedown request and related domains.
Downloads as a file.

The current run (or the last one), the daily schedule and each source's state.
Poll every 2 s while `running`, every 30 s otherwise.

schema.title: Response Radar Runs List Api Radar Runs Get

post.description: Start a radar run now (analyst or admin). Omit `sources` for all, `brands` for every brand.

409.description: A run is already going; the body is {detail, run}

post.description:
Create (or reuse) a case for the URL. Returns a URL-only verdict now and
queues a full fetch; poll GET /api/cases/{case_id} for the final result.
Score many URLs at once without storing them. `?format=csv` returns a file.
Public checker: paste a link or a phone number. No login needed.

get.description: Scam domains for the browser extension to block (public; synced every 10 minutes).

impersonates.title: Impersonates
impersonates.description: Brand id from the registry, if it copies one

asks_for.title: Asks For
asks_for.description: card, cvv, otp, password, emirates_id, bank_login, payment, ...

AiReview.title: AiReview
AiReview.description:
What Claude made of a borderline page (workers/ai_review.py). The engine turns a confident
answer into one reason: ai_flagged (raises the score) or ai_cleared (lowers it).

official_domains.title: Official Domains
official_domains.description: Registrable domains only, e.g. 'tamm.abudhabi'; subdomains count as official

helplines.title: Helplines
helplines.description: As printed on the official site, e.g. '600 54 0000'

domain_tokens.title: Domain Tokens
domain_tokens.description: Strings that betray this brand inside a scam domain, e.g. 'enbd'. 4+ chars

query.title: Query
query.description: Search query, brand keyword or listing search that found it

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: A URL found by the radar or submitted by a person.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand.id the radar matched, if any

details.title: Details
details.description: Radar metadata, e.g. lookalike variant, certificate issuer, search position, Maps flags. details.replayed=true means it came from a saved SerpApi answer

brand_category.title: Brand Category
brand_category.description: Sector of brand_target (bank, police, shopping, ...); null without a brand

source_details.title: Source Details
source_details.description: How the radar found it (docs/radar-ui.md). lookalike: variant; ct: issuer, issued_at; nrd: registered_on; search/search_ad: query, position, title, lang, replayed; maps: listing_name, phone, helpline_mismatch, rating, reviews, replayed

input.title: Input
input.description: A link or a phone number

CloakingCheck.title: CloakingCheck
CloakingCheck.description: Second visit as a foreign desktop browser, compared with the UAE phone visit.

DecisionLogEntry.title: DecisionLogEntry
DecisionLogEntry.description: One confirm / dismiss in the audit log: who, when, why.

DownloadSignal.title: DownloadSignal
DownloadSignal.description: A link or text pushing a remote-access app or an APK install.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Browser profile used for the visit

screenshot_path.title: Screenshot Path
screenshot_path.description: Relative to the artifacts dir; served at /artifacts/<path>

screenshot_sha256.title: Screenshot Sha256
screenshot_sha256.description: Hash of the screenshot file, for the evidence chain

page_kind.title: Page Kind
page_kind.description: 'content' for a real page; otherwise a placeholder: parked, for_sale, expired, blocked, error, coming_soon, default_host_page, empty. Placeholders say nothing about the owner

shared_hosting.title: Shared Hosting
shared_hosting.description: Site lives on a free/shared platform (e.g. *.vercel.app). WHOIS age, registrar and IP then belong to the platform, not the scammer: never read them as trust

fetch_error.title: Fetch Error
fetch_error.description: Set when the page could not be loaded; the engine still scores the URL

ai_review.description: Claude's second look at a borderline page (screenshot + text); null when not asked

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: What the fetcher and enrichment saw for one URL.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Detection engine that produced this export

EvidenceExport.title: EvidenceExport
EvidenceExport.description: Downloadable evidence bundle for one case (GET /api/cases/{id}/export.json).

Fingerprints.title: Fingerprints
Fingerprints.description: Traits that link sites run by the same people (scam network).

sensitive.title: Sensitive
sensitive.description: Sensitive data asked for: password, card, otp, emirates_id, phone, email

FormInfo.title: FormInfo
FormInfo.description: A form on the page. Never contains values typed into it.

counts_by_source.title: Counts By Source
counts_by_source.description: Every case per source, ignoring the filters

counts_by_category.title: Counts By Category
counts_by_category.description: Radar finds per brand sector, ignoring the filters; brand-less finds under 'none'

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Brands this run looked for; null = all

verdicts.title: Verdicts
verdicts.description: Final verdicts of this run's new finds so far (FRAUD, SUSPICIOUS, LEGIT)

checked.title: Checked
checked.description: Page checks finished (or given up on)

total.title: Total
total.description: New finds queued for a page check, highest URL risk first

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Brand ids; omit for all brands

checked.title: Checked
checked.description: Names / tokens / queries checked so far

new.title: New
new.description: Of those, URLs not seen before

note.title: Note
note.description: e.g. needs_key, or the error type when failed

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: False when the source needs a key that isn't set

run.description: The current run while running, else the last one

searches_left.title: Searches Left
searches_left.description: SerpApi searches left this month (null without a key)

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Points this reason adds (negative = lowers risk)

RelatedDomain.title: RelatedDomain
RelatedDomain.description: Another case that shares infrastructure with this one (an edge of GET /api/graph).

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Registrar and host abuse emails, deduplicated

mailto.title: Mailto
mailto.description: mailto: link with the recipients, subject and English body; None without recipients

User.title: User
User.description: An account as admins see it (the password hash is never returned).

VisualMatch.title: VisualMatch
VisualMatch.description: The page reuses an official brand site's favicon or template on a non-official host.

HTTPBearer.description: Log in with POST /api/auth/login and paste the access_token here.
